name: WGP brand mini UPS
description:
Model Type: Multi 3 Output Mini DC UPS
Output Voltages: 5V, 9V, 12V
Battery Capacity: Typically 10400mAh
Backup Time: Provides approximately 6 to 10 hours of backup, depending on the connected devices (eg, router, ONU, CCTV camera).
Features:
Protects devices from overcharge and over-discharge.
Compatible with all branded routers.
